definitions.explanation: To take air into the lungs and expel it, either as an involuntary bodily function or as a deliberate action.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深|ふか}く→深い：01211_fukai⟧{呼吸|こきゅう}して⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{緊張|きんちょう}した→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧{呼吸|こきゅう}する⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: When you're nervous, it's good to breathe slowly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自力|じりき}→自力：08513_jiriki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{呼吸|こきゅう}すること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できなく→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{人工|じんこう}→人工：11573_jinkou⟧⟦{呼吸器|こきゅうき}→呼吸器：06011_kokyuuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧になった。
examples.english: The patient became unable to breathe on their own and needed a ventilator.

notes:
Covers both the involuntary act of breathing and conscious breathing exercises. The noun form ⟦{呼吸|こきゅう}→呼吸：02754_kokyuu⟧ is more common than the verb form and appears in many compounds.

Literally composed of {呼|こ} (to exhale) and {吸|きゅう} (to inhale), though the compound refers to the full breathing cycle.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {深|ふか}{呼吸|こきゅう}: deep breathing
- ⟦{呼吸|こきゅう}→呼吸：02754_kokyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{荒|あら}い→荒い：00466_arai⟧: to be breathing heavily
- ⟦{呼吸|こきゅう}→呼吸：02754_kokyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まる→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧: to stop breathing
- ⟦{呼吸|こきゅう}→呼吸：02754_kokyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧: to regulate one's breathing
- ⟦{人工|じんこう}→人工：11573_jinkou⟧⟦{呼吸|こきゅう}→呼吸：02754_kokyuu⟧: artificial respiration
- {腹式|ふくしき}⟦{呼吸|こきゅう}→呼吸：02754_kokyuu⟧: abdominal breathing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to breathe — the everyday, colloquial way to say "breathe"
- ⟦{吸|す}う→吸う：04394_suu⟧: to inhale; to breathe in — refers only to the inhalation phase
- ⟦{吐|は}く→吐く：04397_haku⟧: to exhale; to breathe out — refers only to the exhalation phase
